limits.resets: Cloudflare documents the free limits as resetting at {{time}} (00:00 UTC); a block can last longer, until the last 24 hours' use falls below the limit (up to 24 h)
limits.monthSoFar: Since {{start}} (UTC), against what Workers Paid includes each month
limits.updated: Updated {{time}}; Cloudflare's analytics lag a few minutes
limits.overageTotal: Estimated cost beyond the included amounts this month: {{usd}} (list prices, plus the $5 monthly minimum).
limits.freeStops: On Workers Free these are hard caps: at 100 % that part of Openlive stops until Cloudflare lifts the block. Cloudflare documents 00:00 UTC, but the limit has been seen to free up only as the last 24 hours' use drops, so allow up to 24 hours. Workers Logs are the exception (below).
limits.empty: No data from Cloudflare for this window yet (its analytics lag a few minutes).

logs.name: Workers Logs events
logs.estimated: Estimated: Worker and Durable Object invocations × {{sampling}} sampling
logs.noteFree: Workers Logs: past 200,000 events a day Cloudflare keeps only 1 % of the logs until 00:00 UTC; Openlive keeps working. Lower the sampling with the setup's --log-sampling. From 1 December 2026 Cloudflare limits logs to 0.5 GB a day instead, and stops keeping them at the limit.
logs.notePaid: Workers Logs: 20 million events a month are included, then $0.60 a million. From 1 December 2026 Cloudflare bills logs by volume instead (50 GB a month included, then $0.25 a GB).

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.intro: Ceilings every space and room stays within, the monthly bandwidth limit, and who can join.
settings.fps120Off: Game 120 (1080p120, ~14 Mbps) and Max 120 (1440p120, ~20 Mbps) are off. Choose 120 fps to offer them; they cost about twice as much per viewer.
settings.fps120Preset: {{name}}: {{rate}} with its lower layers and sound, ~{{size}} an hour per viewer.
settings.presetCapped: {{name}}: the {{cap}} limit leaves its top layer about {{rate}} instead of {{full}}. Raise the maximum bitrate to {{need}} for the full quality.
settings.fps120Capped: The {{cap}} limit leaves its top layer about {{rate}} instead of {{full}}. Raise the maximum bitrate to {{need}} for the full quality.

budget.title: Monthly limit
budget.intro: How much Realtime bandwidth the instance may use each billing cycle. Cloudflare's first 1,000 GB are free; every GB above them costs US$ 0.05.
budget.customDescription: From {{min}} to {{max}}. The amount buys GB above the free {{free}} at US$ 0.05 each.
budget.unlimitedNote: Streams are never blocked for usage. Everyone still sees a notice when usage passes the free tier, and you see the cost so far.

settings.blockDescription: Recommended. New streams are blocked at 95% of the estimated limit; running streams get a warning and end after a 10-minute grace period.
settings.alertsDescription: Streams continue past the limit, and Cloudflare bills every GB above the free tier at US$ 0.05.
settings.autoEconomyDescription: Above 90% of the limit, streams are capped at 1080p and 8 Mbps. Turn it off to keep full quality until the limit.
settings.cycleDayDescription: The day of the month your Cloudflare billing cycle turns over (1 to 31).
settings.overheadsDescription: Count about 1.5× the bitrate plus about 15 MB per viewer join, as measured in Phase 0. Turn it off for the plain formula.
settings.inviteOnlyOn: Recommended. New accounts need an invite link or a room code; existing accounts always sign in.
settings.inviteOnlyOff: Anyone with a Discord account or an e-mail address can create an account.
settings.adminSpaces: Only the platform admin creates spaces
settings.adminSpacesOn: Recommended. Every space streams on your bandwidth quota, so you decide which ones exist.
settings.adminSpacesOff: Anyone signed in can create a space and invite their own group.
settings.backgroundPauseDescription: A viewer whose tab stays in the background for 60 seconds stops receiving video until they come back. Their viewer slot is kept. Picture-in-picture and full screen count as watching.
settings.idleCheckDescription: After 2 hours without any interaction, viewers are asked whether they are still watching. With no answer in 60 seconds, they stop watching and free their slot.
settings.capabilitiesDescription: What spaces and rooms on this instance may have. Turning cameras off saves bandwidth.
settings.maxCamerasCost: Each camera is received by everyone else in voice: 6 cameras on the small strip cost about {{strip}} an hour, about {{large}} if everyone enlarges them. 0 turns cameras off.

av1.description: Streams also send their top layer in AV1 to viewers whose browser decodes it, at about 65 % of the H.264 bitrate to save data or at the same bitrate for a sharper picture, as chosen per preset; everyone else, and every lower layer, stays on H.264. The streamer needs an NVIDIA RTX 40 or newer (or a VA-API GPU that encodes AV1) and uploads the AV1 copy on top. Off until it is measured on real content.

hint.av1Save: Save data: ~35 % less bandwidth, similar picture.
hint.av1Quality: Quality: same bandwidth as H.264, sharper motion.

av1.cost: ~{{h264}} an hour per viewer on H.264, ~{{av1Save}} on AV1 save data, ~{{av1Quality}} on AV1 quality.

openInApp.description: Open this invite in the app, or continue below in the browser.

join.title: Join with code
join.intro: Enter the code of a quick room to join it.
join.label: Room code
join.hint: Ask whoever opened the quick room for its code, like OL-4821-0937.

what.title: Spaces
what.body: A space is a private group with its own rooms and members. Only people you invite can see it.

create.title: Create a space
create.body: Start one for your group, then invite friends to it.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.body: Fixed rooms stay until someone archives them. Quick rooms expire on their own.

quick.title: Quick rooms
quick.body: Open a room for tonight in one click; it closes by itself.

invites.title: Invites
invites.body: Create links for members or guests, to the whole space or one room.

members.title: Members and roles
members.body: Owners and admins manage the space. Guests only watch unless someone lets them stream.

create.title: Create a room
create.body: Pick a template: watch together, stream only, a voice or a text channel.

presence.title: Who is here
presence.body: Everyone in the room right now, live.

streams.title: The stage
streams.body: Live streams and everyone in voice show here as tiles. Watch a stream to see it big.

golive.title: Go live
golive.body: Stream your screen to this room with the helper on your computer.

features.title: Room features
features.body: Choose what the room has: stream, voice, text.

voice.title: Voice
voice.body: Join the room's voice channel to talk while you watch.

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Messages and links for everyone in the room. Type @ to mention someone.

chatButton.title: Chat
chatButton.body: Open the room's messages here. The badge counts what you have not read.

preferences.title: Language and theme
preferences.body: Switch the language and light or dark mode here.

user.title: Your menu
user.body: Settings, where you can replay this tutorial, and signing out.

helpers.title: Your helpers
helpers.body: Each computer with the helper running shows here. Pick the one to stream from.

sources.title: What to share
sources.body: Your screens and windows, with previews only you can see. Nothing is shared until you start.

preset.title: Quality
preset.body: Higher quality needs more upload. The room may set a limit.

audio.title: Sound
audio.body: Send one app's sound, never your whole computer's, so your voice chat is not heard twice.

start.title: Start
start.body: Your helper starts streaming and everyone in the room can watch.

controls.title: While live
controls.body: Pause hides your screen at once. You can change the quality or stop from any device.

search.title: Find anyone
search.body: Search by name, e-mail or id. Every account on the instance is here.

filter.title: Filters
filter.body: Show the accounts in no space, the banned ones or the platform admins.

list.title: Open an account
list.body: Its spaces, sessions, helpers and activity, plus ban, sign-out and delete.

budget.title: Monthly limit
budget.body: Pick the free tier, a larger limit, your own, or none. Each shows its maximum cost and how many full streams fit.

mute.title: Mute
mute.body: Stop sending your microphone. Everyone sees the muted icon.

deafen.title: Deafen
deafen.body: Hear nobody and mute yourself. Lifting it gives your mute back.

devices.title: Devices
devices.body: Pick the microphone and the speakers, and turn on push-to-talk.

panel.title: Voice connected
panel.body: Your voice stays on while you browse. Go back to the room or disconnect from here.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: Show your camera to the others in voice. It stays off until you turn it on.

link.title: Pair a helper
link.intro: Connect the Openlive helper on a computer to your account, so it can stream for you.
link.codeHint: The helper shows a code like K7F-2QM.
link.confirmDescription: A helper on {{os}} ({{arch}}, version {{version}}) asked to pair with code {{code}}. Only approve it if it is your computer.
link.nameHint: Shown in Settings and when the helper is online.
link.pairedDescription: You can go back to the helper: it connects by itself in a few seconds.

appAuthorize.title: Sign in to the app
appAuthorize.question: Allow “Openlive” on {{device}} to use your account on {{instance}}?
appAuthorize.description: Signed in as {{name}}. The app will be able to do what you do here, except administer the instance.
appAuthorize.warning: Only allow it if you just started signing in from the Openlive app on that device. You can revoke it any time in Settings → Sessions.
appAuthorize.backToApp: Go back to the Openlive app. You can close this page.

invalid.title: This sign-in request is not valid
invalid.description: Start signing in again from the Openlive app. Nothing was shared.

player.label: {{name}}'s stream
player.noAudioHint: The streamer did not turn on app audio, so there is no sound to play.

stats.title: Stats for nerds
stats.screenLimit: Your screen is {{hz}} Hz: you are seeing {{hz}} fps of a {{fps}} fps stream.

queue.joinHint: When a slot frees up, you get 30 seconds to take it.
queue.position: You are number {{position}} of {{length}} in line
queue.offer: A slot is free for you

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: {{name}} paused the stream. It picks up here when they resume.
paused.sourceHidden: The window {{name}} is sharing is minimized or hidden. The stream picks up when it is back.

curtain.title: Privacy curtain
curtain.description: {{name}} hid their screen for a moment.

reconnecting.title: Reconnecting…
reconnecting.description: The video stopped arriving. Trying again.

noPermission.title: You can't watch this stream
noPermission.description: Ask an owner or admin of the space for access.

roomExpired.title: This room expired
roomExpired.description: Quick rooms close on their own when their time is up.

helperOffline.title: {{name}}'s helper went offline
helperOffline.description: The stream stopped when the helper lost its connection. It may come back in a moment.

helperOutdated.title: {{name}}'s helper needs an update
helperOutdated.description: This stream comes from a helper version this app can't play. Ask them to update it.

endReason.permission_revoked: {{name}} can no longer stream in this room.
endReason.quota_exhausted: The space used up its bandwidth for the month.

stillWatching.title: Still watching?
stillWatching.description: You haven’t interacted for a while. Watching stops in {{seconds}} s to free your slot for someone else.

golive.title: Go live
golive.description: Your helper streams to this room. You control it from here.
golive.hubEnded: Lost the connection to your helpers. Reload the page.

noPermission.title: You cannot stream here yet
noPermission.body: Ask a moderator of this room for the permission to stream.

offline.title: Your helper is offline
offline.body: Open the Openlive helper on your computer and keep it running. It connects by itself.

source.title: What to share
source.loading: Asking your helper for its screens and windows…
source.empty: Your helper found nothing to share.
source.portalScreen: Choose a screen in the system dialog
source.portalWindow: Choose a window in the system dialog
source.portalHint: Your system shows its own dialog on the computer: pick what to share there.
source.lastHint: Shares this again without the system dialog. To share something else, go back and choose a screen or window.

options.title: Options
options.roomCapTop: The top layer gets about {{rate}} instead of {{full}}.

metrics.spaceIntro: How streams in this space played: first frame, freezes, drops, the helpers and the most frequent errors.
metrics.adminIntro: How streams played across the instance, and per space.
metrics.empty: No streams or viewers in this period yet.

helper.title: Helpers
helper.none: No helper reports in this period.

unavailable.notConfigured: Status needs a Cloudflare API token
unavailable.notConfiguredHint: Set {{missing}} on the Worker (the usage meter uses the same token). Metrics are being recorded in the meantime.
unavailable.permission: The Cloudflare API token cannot read the metrics
unavailable.permissionHint: Give the token the {{permission}} permission. Metrics are being recorded in the meantime.
unavailable.failedHint: Cloudflare's analytics did not answer. Try again in a minute.

stream.label: Stream
stream.description: The stream grid and the player.

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: A voice channel to talk while you watch.

camera.label: Camera
camera.description: Cameras in the voice channel. Needs voice.

text.label: Text
text.description: A text chat for messages and links.

capabilities.atLeastOne: Turn on at least one of stream, voice and text.

streamOnly.label: Stream only
streamOnly.description: Streams, like rooms have been so far.

voice.label: Voice channel
voice.description: Talk without a screen. Cameras optional.

voice.title: Voice
voice.outputUnsupported: This browser plays voice on the system's speakers.
voice.pressAKey: Press a key for push-to-talk (Esc cancels).

status.sending: Your microphone is on: the others hear you.
status.deafened: Deafened: you hear nobody and are muted.
status.pushToTalk: Push to talk: hold {{key}} while this tab is focused.

voice.listenOnly: You are in voice, listening only.

micError.denied: The browser blocked the microphone. Allow it in the site settings to speak.
micError.unsupported: This browser cannot use the microphone on this page.

removed.kicked: A moderator removed you from voice.
removed.removed: You no longer have access to this room.
removed.moved: Your voice moved to another tab.
removed.capability_disabled: Voice was turned off in this room.

headphones.tip: Tip: headphones sound better. Echo cancellation is on.

settings.title: Voice
settings.description: Your microphone, speakers and push-to-talk for voice channels, on this browser.
settings.hint: Device names show once you have allowed the microphone.

camera.notAllowed: Cameras are off for you in this room.
camera.paused: Cameras paused: the connection is weak, so voice comes first.
camera.lowQuality: Cameras in low quality: the connection is unstable.

error.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in the browser to turn the camera on.
error.unsupported: This browser cannot use a camera here.

stopped.moderator: A moderator turned your camera off.
stopped.quota_exhausted: Your camera was turned off: this month's bandwidth is used up. Voice keeps working.
stopped.capability_disabled: Cameras were turned off in this room.
stopped.not_allowed: You can no longer use a camera in this room.
stopped.limit: Your camera was turned off: the room now allows fewer cameras.

session.label: Voice connected in {{room}}
session.switchBody: You will leave the voice in {{room}}.

echo.title: People in voice will hear themselves in your stream
echo.body: The stream captures this browser's audio. Use another browser for the window you share, or share without audio.

ducking.label: Lower the stream while someone speaks
ducking.hint: The stream you watch gets quieter while someone in your voice talks, and comes back after.

voice.boostWarning: Above 100 % without headphones, echo cancellation may not cover this voice.

tips.ios: On iPhone and iPad, keep this tab open with the screen on: the browser cuts the microphone in the background.

chat.title: Chat
chat.readOnly: Guests can read this chat but not write in it.
chat.editHint: Enter to save, Esc to cancel.

delete.title: Delete this message?
delete.own: It is deleted for everyone. This cannot be undone.
delete.other: As a moderator you delete it for everyone. This cannot be undone.

chat.mentionElsewhere: You were mentioned in a room's chat

retention.none: No history: messages go when the room empties
retention.quick: Messages go when the room ends

settings.retentionHint: Older messages are deleted automatically. Longer options may be limited by the space.
settings.noHistoryHint: Messages are deleted as soon as everyone leaves the room.
settings.guestsCanWriteHint: Guests can always read the chat.

notices.streamDroppedHint: The helper lost its connection or stopped with an error.
notices.streamUnstableHint: Viewers may see a lower quality until it recovers.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Short sounds in the app, each with a message on screen. They play while this tab is open, also in the background, once you have clicked on the page.

kinds.queueSlot: A slot opens in the queue
kinds.streamProblem: Your stream drops or your network is unstable
kinds.mention: Someone mentions you in a chat
kinds.voiceOthers: Someone joins or leaves your voice

hints.streamStarted: In a room you have open.
hints.queueSlot: You have 30 seconds to take it.
hints.viewerJoined: Off unless you turn it on.
hints.mention: In a room whose chat is not open.
hints.voiceSelf: A sound only: the button already shows it.
hints.voiceOthers: In the voice you are in.

pointer.allowHint: Viewers can click your stream to show a pulsing marker with their name on your screen. Nothing is clicked on your computer.
pointer.allowGoLiveHint: Viewers can point at your screen with a pulsing marker and their name. Nothing is clicked on your computer. Works when your helper can draw the clicks.
pointer.unsupported: Visual clicks need a helper that can draw them on your screen.
pointer.keyHint: Arrow keys move, Enter clicks, Esc leaves
pointer.rateLimited: Too many clicks. Wait a moment.

settings.title: Pointer
settings.description: How your visual clicks look on someone's screen, when they allow them. For this browser.
